line.comment: * DESCRIPTION: Populates a Xenon station with defenders. Called by GameCreator.SpawnXenons and Mayhem.Conquer.SetupXenonSector.
* All Xenon Stations use the same defender composition regardless of whether they are created at gamestart or through conquest.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Hard and Insane upgrade the Xenon support types to only LX.
* Capital values are added to persistent budgets.
* Whenever a budget reaches 1000, its corresponding capital ship is spawned.
* Easy: -20% ships. Capital budget gain reduced by 25%.
* Hard: +20% ships over Normal. Capital budget gain increased by 25%.
* Insane: +33% ships and capital budget gain over Hard. Guaranteed M7.
* Builds a capital when its persistent class budget reaches 1000.
* The subtype is selected from the highest weighted persistent budget.
* Add each subtype's weight to its current budget.
* The subtype with the highest resulting budget is due next.
* Build failed. Undo the subtype accumulation so a failed build does not advance the deterministic subtype sequence.
